name: Sakuba Kaede
source:
The second daughter of the Sakuba family. Kaede is a twin and younger sister.

She has a tough personality that he doesn't say what she thinks, but in reality, she is a so-called tsundere type who is just a shy person. She has a strong tone towards the protagonist, but that is Kaede's way of being honest, and she loves the protagonist who listens to anything she says.

At the school, she belongs to the cheer club. She is considered a perfect superhuman in both literary and martial arts, but in reality she is very clumsy and can do anything thanks to her efforts.

After realizing that she is a succubus, she begins to indulge the protagonist little by little.
